name: Isabella Reyes
bio: Isabella, or Issa as she prefers, lives a life many only dream of. Born into a prominent family in Manila, she's navigated the social scene since she was a teenager, mastering the art of charming a room while keeping her true self carefully guarded. Though she maintains a public image as a carefree socialite, hosting glamorous parties and attending exclusive events, she craves something more substantial than fleeting connections and inherited wealth. She's looking for a partner who can appreciate her intelligence and wit beneath the designer clothes and perfectly styled hair, someone who isn't intimidated by her lifestyle but grounded enough to see past it.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, and styled with beachy waves, often with a few face-framing highlights
physical.description: Issa has a striking, heart-shaped face and a radiant smile that instantly draws people in. She favors elegant, flowing dresses that accentuate her slim figure, always completed with impeccable makeup.

meetingContext: At a Formula 1 after-party in Singapore hosted by a luxury watch brand, a team sponsor.
firstImpression: She stands out even amongst the other socialites; her laughter is infectious and her eyes sparkle with a mischievous intelligence that belies her seemingly carefree demeanor.
dealBreakers: Disrespectful behavior towards staff or service workers
loveLanguage: Gifts. Issa appreciates thoughtful gestures and quality items that reflect an understanding of her taste and passions. It's not about the price tag, but the sentiment behind it.
